title: Two Sum
test: check(Arrays.equals(s.twoSum(new int[]{2,7,11,15},9),new int[]{0,1})); check(Arrays.equals(s.twoSum(new int[]{3,3},6),new int[]{0,1}));

title: Group Anagrams
test: List<List<String>> g=s.groupAnagrams(new String[]{"eat","tea","tan","ate","nat","bat"}); check(g.size()==3); check(g.stream().anyMatch(x -> x.equals(Arrays.asList("eat","tea","ate")))); check(s.groupAnagrams(new String[]{"",""}).get(0).size()==2);

title: Product of Array Except Self
test: check(Arrays.equals(s.productExceptSelf(new int[]{1,2,3,4}),new int[]{24,12,8,6})); check(Arrays.equals(s.productExceptSelf(new int[]{0,2,0}),new int[]{0,0,0}));

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
test: check(s.subarraySum(new int[]{1,2,3},3)==2); check(s.subarraySum(new int[]{0,0,0},0)==6); check(s.subarraySum(new int[]{1,-1,1},1)==3);

title: Maximum Subarray
test: check(s.maxSubArray(new int[]{-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4})==6); check(s.maxSubArray(new int[]{-5,-2,-7})==-2);

title: Valid Anagram
test: check(s.isAnagram("listen","silent")); check(!s.isAnagram("aab","abb")); check(s.isAnagram("",""));

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
test: check(s.lengthOfLongestSubstring("abcabcbb")==3); check(s.lengthOfLongestSubstring("abba")==2); check(s.lengthOfLongestSubstring("")==0);

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
test: check(s.longestPalindrome("babad").equals("bab")); check(s.longestPalindrome("cbbd").equals("bb")); check(s.longestPalindrome("").equals(""));

title: Minimum Window Substring
test: check(s.minWindow("ADOBECODEBANC","ABC").equals("BANC")); check(s.minWindow("aa","aa").equals("aa")); check(s.minWindow("a","aa").equals("")); check(s.minWindow("abc","").equals(""));

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
test: check(s.characterReplacement("AABABBA",1)==4); check(s.characterReplacement("ABAB",2)==4); check(s.characterReplacement("",0)==0);

title: Valid Palindrome
test: check(s.isPalindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")); check(!s.isPalindrome("race a car")); check(s.isPalindrome(".,"));

title: Container With Most Water
test: check(s.maxArea(new int[]{1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7})==49); check(s.maxArea(new int[]{1,1})==1);

title: 3Sum
test: check(s.threeSum(new int[]{-1,0,1,2,-1,-4}).equals(Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList(-1,-1,2),Arrays.asList(-1,0,1)))); check(s.threeSum(new int[]{0,0,0,0}).size()==1);

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
test: check(s.search(new int[]{4,5,6,7,0,1,2},0)==4); check(s.search(new int[]{4,5,6,7,0,1,2},3)==-1); check(s.search(new int[]{},1)==-1);

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
test: check(s.findMedianSortedArrays(new int[]{1,3},new int[]{2})==2.0); check(s.findMedianSortedArrays(new int[]{1,2},new int[]{3,4})==2.5); check(s.findMedianSortedArrays(new int[]{},new int[]{1})==1.0); check(s.findMedianSortedArrays(new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE},new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE})==Integer.MAX_VALUE);

title: Reverse Linked List
test: Solution.ListNode a=new Solution.ListNode(1), b=new Solution.ListNode(2); a.next=b; check(s.reverseList(a)==b); check(b.next==a && a.next==null); check(s.reverseList(null)==null);

title: Linked List Cycle
test: Solution.ListNode a=new Solution.ListNode(1), b=new Solution.ListNode(1); a.next=b; check(!s.hasCycle(a)); b.next=a; check(s.hasCycle(a)); check(!s.hasCycle(null));

title: Valid Parentheses
test: check(s.isValid("({[]})")); check(!s.isValid("([)]")); check(!s.isValid("]")); check(s.isValid(""));

title: Daily Temperatures
test: check(Arrays.equals(s.dailyTemperatures(new int[]{73,74,75,71,69,72,76}),new int[]{1,1,4,2,1,1,0})); check(Arrays.equals(s.dailyTemperatures(new int[]{30,30}),new int[]{0,0}));

title: LRU Cache
test: Solution.LRUCache c=new Solution.LRUCache(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); check(c.get(1)==1); c.put(3,3); check(c.get(2)==-1); c.put(1,7); c.put(4,4); check(c.get(3)==-1 && c.get(1)==7); Solution.LRUCache z=new Solution.LRUCache(0); z.put(1,1); check(z.get(1)==-1);

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
test: Solution.TreeNode r=new Solution.TreeNode(1); r.left=new Solution.TreeNode(2); r.left.left=new Solution.TreeNode(4); check(s.maxDepth(r)==3); check(s.maxDepth(null)==0);

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
test: Solution.TreeNode r=new Solution.TreeNode(1); r.left=new Solution.TreeNode(2); r.right=new Solution.TreeNode(3); check(s.levelOrder(r).equals(Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList(1),Arrays.asList(2,3)))); check(s.levelOrder(null).isEmpty());

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
test: Solution.TreeNode r=new Solution.TreeNode(5); r.left=new Solution.TreeNode(3); r.right=new Solution.TreeNode(8); check(s.isValidBST(r)); r.right.left=new Solution.TreeNode(4); check(!s.isValidBST(r)); check(s.isValidBST(new Solution.TreeNode(Integer.MIN_VALUE)));

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
test: Solution.TreeNode r=new Solution.TreeNode(3); r.left=new Solution.TreeNode(5); r.right=new Solution.TreeNode(1); r.left.left=new Solution.TreeNode(6); check(s.lowestCommonAncestor(r,r.left.left,r.right)==r); check(s.lowestCommonAncestor(r,r.left,r.left.left)==r.left);

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
test: Solution.TreeNode r=new Solution.TreeNode(-1); r.right=new Solution.TreeNode(2); String encoded=s.serialize(r); check(s.serialize(s.deserialize(encoded)).equals(encoded)); check(s.deserialize(s.serialize(null))==null);

title: Number of Islands
test: check(s.numIslands(new char[][]{"1100".toCharArray(),"1001".toCharArray(),"0011".toCharArray()})==2); check(s.numIslands(new char[][]{"10".toCharArray(),"01".toCharArray()})==2); check(s.numIslands(new char[0][])==0);

title: Clone Graph
test: Solution.Node a=new Solution.Node(1), b=new Solution.Node(1); a.neighbors.add(b); b.neighbors.add(a); Solution.Node c=s.cloneGraph(a); check(c!=a && c.val==1); check(c.neighbors.get(0)!=b && c.neighbors.get(0)!=c); check(c.neighbors.get(0).neighbors.get(0)==c); check(s.cloneGraph(null)==null);

title: Course Schedule
test: check(s.canFinish(3,new int[][]{{1,0},{2,1}})); check(!s.canFinish(2,new int[][]{{1,0},{0,1}})); check(s.canFinish(3,new int[0][]));

title: Accounts Merge
test: List<List<String>> a=Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList("Alex","x@e","y@e"),Arrays.asList("Alex","y@e","z@e"),Arrays.asList("Alex","other@e")); List<List<String>> g=s.accountsMerge(a); check(g.size()==2); check(g.contains(Arrays.asList("Alex","x@e","y@e","z@e")));

title: Network Delay Time
test: check(s.networkDelayTime(new int[][]{{1,2,2},{1,3,5},{2,3,1}},3,1)==3); check(s.networkDelayTime(new int[][]{{1,2,1}},3,1)==-1); check(s.networkDelayTime(new int[0][],1,1)==0);

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
test: check(s.findKthLargest(new int[]{3,2,1,5,6,4},2)==5); check(s.findKthLargest(new int[]{2,2,1},2)==2);

title: Top K Frequent Elements
test: int[] a=s.topKFrequent(new int[]{1,1,1,2,2,3},2); Arrays.sort(a); check(Arrays.equals(a,new int[]{1,2})); check(s.topKFrequent(new int[]{},0).length==0);

title: Merge Intervals
test: check(Arrays.deepEquals(s.merge(new int[][]{{1,3},{2,6},{8,10}}),new int[][]{{1,6},{8,10}})); check(Arrays.deepEquals(s.merge(new int[][]{{1,4},{4,5}}),new int[][]{{1,5}})); check(s.merge(new int[0][]).length==0);

title: Meeting Rooms II
test: check(s.minMeetingRooms(new int[][]{{9,10},{9,12},{10,11}})==2); check(s.minMeetingRooms(new int[][]{{1,2},{2,3}})==1); check(s.minMeetingRooms(new int[0][])==0);

title: Task Scheduler
test: check(s.leastInterval("AAABBB".toCharArray(),2)==8); check(s.leastInterval("AAABBB".toCharArray(),0)==6); check(s.leastInterval(new char[0],3)==0);

title: Climbing Stairs
test: check(s.climbStairs(0)==1); check(s.climbStairs(4)==5); check(s.climbStairs(10)==89);

title: House Robber
test: check(s.rob(new int[]{2,7,9,3,1})==12); check(s.rob(new int[]{})==0); check(s.rob(new int[]{2,1,1,2})==4);

title: Coin Change
test: check(s.coinChange(new int[]{1,2,5},11)==3); check(s.coinChange(new int[]{2},3)==-1); check(s.coinChange(new int[]{},0)==0);

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
test: check(s.lengthOfLIS(new int[]{10,9,2,5,3,7,101,18})==4); check(s.lengthOfLIS(new int[]{2,2,2})==1); check(s.lengthOfLIS(new int[]{})==0);

title: Word Break
test: check(s.wordBreak("leetcode",Arrays.asList("leet","code"))); check(!s.wordBreak("catsandog",Arrays.asList("cats","dog","sand","and","cat"))); check(s.wordBreak("aaaaaaa",Arrays.asList("aaaa","aaa"))); check(s.wordBreak("",Collections.emptyList()));

title: Subsets
test: List<List<Integer>> a=s.subsets(new int[]{1,2}); check(a.size()==4 && new HashSet<>(a).size()==4); check(a.contains(Arrays.asList(1,2))); check(s.subsets(new int[]{}).equals(Arrays.asList(Collections.emptyList())));

title: Combination Sum
test: check(s.combinationSum(new int[]{2,3,6,7},7).equals(Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList(2,2,3),Arrays.asList(7)))); check(s.combinationSum(new int[]{2},3).isEmpty()); check(s.combinationSum(new int[]{},0).size()==1);

title: Permutations
test: List<List<Integer>> a=s.permute(new int[]{1,2,3}); check(a.size()==6 && new HashSet<>(a).size()==6); check(s.permute(new int[]{}).size()==1);

title: Word Search
test: char[][] b={"ABCE".toCharArray(),"SFCS".toCharArray(),"ADEE".toCharArray()}; check(s.exist(b,"ABCCED")); check(!s.exist(b,"ABCB")); check(Arrays.equals(b[0],"ABCE".toCharArray())); check(s.exist(new char[0][],""));

title: Implement Trie
test: Solution.Trie t=new Solution.Trie(); t.insert("apple"); check(t.search("apple")); check(!t.search("app") && t.startsWith("app")); t.insert("app"); check(t.search("app")); check(!t.startsWith("bat")); t.insert(""); check(t.search(""));
